meta.name: Copper sulphate
meta.positioning: Real 2025+ foreign buy-side demand for this Iran-sourced product (verified + de-noised).
meta.note: Moderate but narrow. The only reliably verifiable 2025+ FOREIGN buy-side demand is small-tonnage public water-treatment procurement: recurring US municipal bids (Fairfax VA, Watertown NY, Middletown CT), Indian municipal water works, plus a niche UK reagent-grade NHSBT framework. Bulk agri/industrial tonnage (1,000+ t) appears almost only as anonymous, largely unverifiable leads on low-trust B2B aggregators (go4WorldBusiness, TradeKey), so genuine bulk foreign demand on the public web is thin and low-confidence. Dropped 3 aggregator leads (Egypt 'Mr. Mahmood' anonymous, Turkey 'Farzam Group' Iran-linkage risk, Spain 'AQUA ADVANCE CORP' no independent footprint) as failing the real-entity / outside-Iran tests.
